messages:
alex_m: morning—quick standup thread: GPU pressure on the hotpath after yesterday's canary. TL;DR: us-west2 prewarm didn't fully spin up, some jobs spilled to ondemand and we saw token latency spikes. filing INF-529.

maya: saw the same. looking at the autoscaler logs now. hypothesis: the prewarm lambda timed out at ~02:14 and didn't mark pool ready.

liang: pinged cloud-quotas—we're at 92% of our regional gpu quota in us-west2 (nvidia-a100-sXM4). if we need more short term I can submit a provisional quota bump request (GCP) and attach the expected CPU/GPU counts.

alex_m: thanks. maya, can you paste the autoscaler error lines? also @liang what's the ETA on the quota request? we might prefer shifting canary to us-central for the next 2 hours instead of a quota bump.

maya: error excerpt: `ERROR autoscaler: prewarm handler: timeout waiting for pool readiness (timeout=120s)`. root cause looks like the init script on the warm instances failed to fetch the model artifact (403 from internal blobstore).

maya: reproduction command I ran: `kubectl logs deploy/prewarm-controller -n infra --since=30m | grep prewarm` shows repeated 403 on the artifact download step. pushing a quick rollback of the artifact ACL change I made at 01:50.

liang: quota request in progress — I already started a support ticket with GCP (case 123456789). provisional ETA from support: 4–6 hours, not great. alternative: shift canary to us-central and spin up smaller batch sizes.

alex_m: ok action items: 1) @maya revert ACL change (if not already) — patch incoming? 2) @liang open a temporary routing rule to prefer us-central for canary (no infra code change, just routing override in the rollout config) 3) i'll prepare a terraform dry-run to add a small spare node pool if GCP approves quota.

maya: ACL rollback PR: #8421 opened, includes rollback and extra retry logic for the artifact fetch. short snippet in the PR: ```bash
# retry fetch with backoff
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -f $ARTIFACT_URL && break || sleep $((i*2))
done
```

liang: routing override ready — will flip canary to us-central at 10:05 PT. per my checks us-central has headroom — we should expect ~15% latency change in cold start profile.

sara-k: quick note on capacity accounting — if we spin an extra small pool in us-west2, remember to subtract from customer-dedicated buffer. filed CR for allocation change: INF-530.

alex_m: thanks @sara-k — we'll only add pool if quota approved. for now plan: rotate canary -> us-central, merge #8421, monitor for 1h, and keep the quota ticket warm.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing override applied to model-x at 10:05:12 PT. Old route: us-west2-primary, New route: us-central-prefer.

maya: merged #8421 — rolling restart prewarm-controller. watching logs. :eyes:

liang: support updated GCP case: they can expedite if we provide expected GPU count + justification. i'll draft a short note, anyone object to me saying "short-term capacity to support canary and surge testing"?

sara-k: fine with that wording. please include INF-529 and INF-530 in the case.

alex_m: no objections. final check: blockers?

maya: none once restart completes. will report back in 20m.

liang: no blockers on my end, routing flip executed.

sara-k: monitoring dashboards updated for new pool movements. I'll watch cost delta.

alex_m: great—closing this async standup. follow-ups: INF-529 (incident), INF-530 (capacity CR), PR #8421. :thumbsup:
